title: Interview day
subtitle: Run through this the evening before and the morning of.

sections.title: Evening before
items: Re-read the job description and underline 3 things they care about
Use the product for 15 minutes and write down 2 improvements
Rehearse your 'Tell me about yourself' out loud (under 2 minutes)
Pick 6 STAR stories and map each to a question type
Prepare 3 questions to ask the interviewer

sections.title: Morning of
items: Check the company's latest news or launches
Do one guesstimate warm-up out loud
Pen, paper and water within reach
Test camera, mic and internet 15 minutes early

sections.title: In the room
items: Say your structure out loud before going deep
Pick one option and justify it
